title: The Stamp Tramp
cn: 第 7 集 · 印章浪子
novel: Marshall [[recommended|recommend]] his old friend Brad for a job at his law firm. He vouched for Brad and said he was a good worker. Marshall felt [[confident|confident]] that Brad would do well. However, things went terribly [[wrong|wrong]]. Brad showed up to the interview [[unprepared|unprepared]] and acted [[unprofessionally|unprofessional]]. He made a bad impression on everyone at the firm. Marshall was [[embarrassed|embarrass]] and felt responsible for Brad's behavior. He tried to [[apologize|apologize]] to his boss, but the damage was done. Marshall learned that vouching for someone was a serious responsibility. Meanwhile, Robin helped Barney return to the strip club. Barney had been [[banned|ban]] from the club after an [[incident|incident]] with Quinn. Robin used her connections to get Barney back in. She talked to the manager and [[convinced|convince]] him to give Barney another chance. Barney was [[grateful|grateful]] to Robin for helping him. He said he owed her a big favor. Robin told him not to worry about it and said that was what friends were for. The two shared a moment of genuine friendship that made Robin feel happy. She realized that she and Barney could be good friends, even if they were not together romantically. Marshall eventually confronted Brad about his behavior and told him he had [[disappointed|disappoint]] him. Brad apologized and promised to do better next time.

recommend.en: to suggest someone for a job

wrong.en: in a bad or incorrect way

ban.en: to not allow someone to enter
